Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 ld_from_date DATE;
 ld_to_date DATE;
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 
 ld_from_date := :ctrl_blk_1.S_FROM_DATE;
 ld_to_date := :ctrl_blk_1.S_TO_DATE;
 
 IF ld_from_date IS NOT NULL THEN
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled,
 :GLOBAL.tz_offset,
 SYSDATE);
 IF ld_from_date > TRUNC(chp_sysdate) THEN
 show_error('18014');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 IF ld_from_date > NVL(ld_to_date, ld_from_date+1) THEN
 show_error('7029');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 END IF;
 
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 lv_status VARCHAR2(1000);
 nCnt NUMBER;
begin

 if :ctrl_blk_1.opt_don_def is null then
 show_error('0080', ' Option');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is null then
 show_error('0080', 'From Date');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date is null then
 show_error('0080', 'To Date');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 :ctrl_blk_1.session_id := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYMMDDHH24MISSSS');
 
 don_nursing_audit.start_process(p_session_id => :ctrl_blk_1.session_id,
 p_id_type => :ctrl_blk_1.opt_don_def,
 p_from_date => :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date,
 p_to_date => :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date,
 p_user_id => lt_user_session.get_userid, 
 p_chapter_id => :GLOBAL.chapter_id, 
 p_program_id => :BANNER.prog_name,
 p_status => lv_status);
 
 if lv_status <> 'OK' then
 if lv_status = '9188' then
 show_error('9188'); -- no records found;
 check_package_failure;
 elsif lv_status = '23015' then
 show_error('23015');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('23012', lv_status);
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 else
 select count(1) into nCnt
 from nursing_audit_manual
 where session_id = :ctrl_blk_1.session_id;
 
 if nCnt = 0 then 
 show_error('9188');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 go_block('NAM');
 :system.message_level := '10';
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := '0';
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.pb_retrieve', 'D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk_2.pb_commit', 'E'); 
 item_change('toolbar.commit_form', 'E'); 
 end if;
 end if;
 
 
end;

PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
 rg_id_op RecordGroup;
 ret_val number; 
 query_str varchar2(400); 
 chp_sysdate DATE; 
 lv_chp_sysdate VARCHAR2(100);
BEGIN
 --:global.program_version := '01';
-- :global.program_version := '02';
 -- :global.program_version := '03'; -- MLT- 1605
 -- :global.program_version := '04'; -- The Audit button was hidden due to the update audit function is not working correctly
 -- :global.program_version := '05'; -- The Audit button was enabled after fixing the issue
 -- :global.program_version := '06'; -- MLT 2953
 -- :global.program_version := '07'; -- MLT 6869
 :global.program_version := '08'; -- MLT 7542

 execute_trigger('util_banner');
 
 set_item_property('nam.s_id_value', PROMPT_TEXT, 'Unit/Deferral');
 
 rg_id_op := FIND_GROUP('OPT');
 IF not ID_NULL(rg_id_op) THEN
 DELETE_GROUP(rg_id_op);
 END IF;
 
 chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 lv_chp_sysdate := TO_CHAR(chp_sysdate, 'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI');

 query_str := 'SELECT description, description ' || -- IM 695 (rg group must have two columns one for label and one for value)
 'FROM valid_master_codes ' ||
 'WHERE code_type = ''ADTPG''' || 
 'AND TO_DATE(''' || lv_chp_sysdate || ''', ''MMDDYYYY HH24:MI'') between eff_date and nvl(term_date,TO_DATE(''' || lv_chp_sysdate || ''', ''MMDDYYYY HH24:MI''))';
 
 
 rg_id_op := CREATE_GROUP_FROM_QUERY('OPT',query_str);
 ret_val := POPULATE_GROUP(rg_id_op);
 IF ret_val != 0 THEN
 message('Audit cannot be done using this program');
 exit_form(no_validate);
 END IF;
 POPULATE_LIST('CTRL_BLK_1.OPT_DON_DEF',rg_id_op); -- IM 695 (this is causing issue in Forms 12c - Workaround applied from Oracle Support)
 :CTRL_BLK_1.OPT_DON_DEF := 'Donation'; -- IM 695 (initial value property removed and this stmt added)
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.pb_retrieve', 'E'); 
 item_change('ctrl_blk_2.pb_commit', 'D'); 
 item_change('toolbar.commit_form', 'D'); 
 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: COMPARISON
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
Function COMPARISON (val1 varchar2, val2 varchar2)
Return number is
 answer number := 0;
Begin 
 if val1 <> NVL(val2,'@') then 
 answer := 1; 
 end if;
 return(answer); 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: TOTALS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION totals(p_type IN VARCHAR2, p_exclude_flag IN VARCHAR2, p_status IN VARCHAR2) RETURN NUMBER IS
BEGIN
 
 IF p_type = 'TOTAL_CNT' THEN
 IF NVL(p_exclude_flag,'#@') <> 'X' THEN
 RETURN 1;
 END IF;
 ELSIF p_type = 'OK_CNT' THEN
 IF NVL(p_exclude_flag,'#@') <> 'X' AND p_status = 'OK' THEN
 RETURN 1;
 END IF;
 ELSIF p_type = 'HOLD_CNT' THEN
 IF NVL(p_exclude_flag,'#@') <> 'X' AND p_status <> 'OK' THEN
 RETURN 1;
 END IF; 
 END IF;
 
 RETURN 0;
 
END totals;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_WINDOW_PROGRAM

PROCEDURE call_window_program (pl_unit_def varchar2) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dondata'; 
BEGIN 

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;

 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_unit_def', TEXT_PARAMETER, Substr(pl_unit_def,1,13));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_chapter_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :global.chapter_id); 

 if Length(pl_unit_def) = 8 then 
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_coll_date', TEXT_PARAMETER, to_char(:donations.coll_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')); 
 call_form( lower('drudfaud') ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,NO_QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
 else
 call_form( lower('drureaud') ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,NO_QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
 end if;
 
 
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 p_status VARCHAR2(500);
BEGIN
 
 :system.message_level := '10';
 COMMIT_FORM;
 :system.message_level := '0';
 
 DON_NURSING_AUDIT.DO_COMMIT(p_status);
 
 IF NVL(p_status,'@#') = 'OK' THEN
 show_error('16116');
 check_package_failure;
 clear_form(no_validate);
 initialise_windows;
 elsif NVL(p_status,'@#') <> 'OK' THEN
 SHOW_ERROR('23014', p_status);
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 MESSAGE('Failed - ' || SUBSTR(SQLERRM, 1, 300)); 
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE; 
END;
